AmielJohn.title: The Snack Strategist
AmielJohn.lore: Elysium's perpetually hungry tactician who's developed a complex battle-snacking rotation that guarantees victory. Has never actually finished a snack before getting hungry again. Shares snacks with M1ssy despite their mutual allergies/starvation. Credits every victory to the perfect jerky-to-combat ratio while simultaneously starving. Goblok appointed them 'Guild Quartermaster' - they ate the supplies.
AmielJohn.specialty: Mid-battle meal optimization that never satisfies
AmielJohn.reputation: Elysium's most well-fed warrior who's perpetually hungry

Azryth.title: Nightblade Philosopher
Azryth.lore: Elysium's deadly shadow assassin who strikes with lethal precision from the darkness. Afraid of the dark. Carries a nightlight to every guild assassination. Philosophical debates help distract from crippling fear of shadows. Enemies die laughing at the irony before the blade even reaches them. Requests LXRDGRIM's therapy for darkness phobia. Goblok assigned them 'Night Raids' anyway. Elysium's most ironic shadow warrior.
Azryth.specialty: Existential combat theory performed in well-lit areas
Azryth.reputation: Elysium's most feared assassin who sleeps with lights on

Byakko.title: The White Tiger Who Lost His Roar
Byakko.lore: Named after the legendary White Tiger guardian deity of the West, whose roar shakes mountains. Chronic laryngitis. The divine roar comes out as tiny squeaks. Mountains remain unshaken. Enemies die laughing instead of fear. The other guardian deities (Genbu, Suzaku, Seiryu) pretend not to know him. Most adorable celestial beast.
Byakko.reputation: The guardian deity the legends forgot to mention has a voice problem
Byakko.stats: Divine Power 100 | Roar Volume 5 | Cuteness 999 | Celestial Shame 90

Carrera.title: Speed Demon
Carrera.lore: Moves faster than light itself - physics has filed a restraining order. Always late. Arrives at battles three hours after they end. Speed so incredible it loops back to being slow. Time dilation makes every arrival perfectly mistimed. Fastest person to miss every event.
Carrera.specialty: Supersonic combat arrival at wrong temporal coordinates
Carrera.reputation: Faster than everyone but last to arrive to everything
Carrera.stats: Speed 999 | Punctuality 0 | Time Dilation 100 | Event Attendance -50

CheeseCakee.title: The Dessert Destroyer
CheeseCakee.lore: Master baker who weaponized confections into lethal combat art. Lactose intolerant. Every creation causes personal gastrointestinal warfare. Enemies die deliciously while CheeseCakee suffers magnificently. True dedication - willing to endure for the craft. The sweetest suffering.
CheeseCakee.reputation: The only member whose attacks hurt them more than enemies

Chunchunmaru.title: The Legendary Blade
Chunchunmaru.lore: Wields the most powerful legendary sword in existence with a name that strikes fear. Named it 'Chunchunmaru' to intimidate foes. Backfired - enemies die laughing. This was the plan all along. Claims it was strategic. Nobody believes him. Strategy works anyway. Accidental genius.
Chunchunmaru.reputation: Most powerful weapon wielded by biggest comedian
Chunchunmaru.stats: Sword Power 100 | Naming Skill 5 | Comedy 95 | Intentionality 10

Daleee.title: The Accidental Savior
Daleee.lore: Genius mage with perfect spell accuracy. Every spell does the opposite. Aims fireball at enemy, heals them. Aims heal at ally, nukes them. Aims nuke at everyone, grants immortality. Pattern discovered - aim at allies to destroy enemies. Reverse psychology magic.
Daleee.specialty: Inverse spellcasting that requires backward thinking
Daleee.reputation: Right in every way that's wrong, perfect through complete failure
Daleee.stats: Spell Power 100 | Accuracy 100 | Intended Effect 0 | Reverse Mastery 95

Enaira.title: The Digital Currency Disaster
Enaira.lore: Named after Nigeria's eNaira digital currency meant to revolutionize the economy. Revolutionized nothing. Adoption rate: 0%. Every transaction fails. Blockchain permanently broken. Created to digitize wealth, actually digitizes poverty. The Central Bank pretends this never happened. Most unsuccessful cryptocurrency named after a successful person.
Enaira.specialty: Economic disruption through catastrophic blockchain failure
Enaira.reputation: The digital currency even crypto bros won't defend
Enaira.stats: Adoption Rate 0% | Transaction Success 0 | Hype 100 | Actual Value -99

EoriuX.title: The Self-Wounded Shadow
EoriuX.lore: Master assassin with legendary stealth and deadly precision daggers. Only enemy is self. Has stabbed themselves more than all enemies combined. Enemies surrender out of pity. Local healers have a dedicated 'EoriuX Emergency Fund'. Still terrifying somehow.
EoriuX.specialty: Accidental self-harm mastery and sympathy intimidation
EoriuX.reputation: The guild's biggest healing supplies customer and bulk discount holder

erwarrr.title: The Screaming Spellcaster
erwarrr.lore: Powerful mage who discovered volume amplifies spell power. Mute. Every 'scream' is complete silence. The silent intensity is more terrifying than actual screaming. Enemies surrender to avoid the uncomfortable quiet. Weaponized awkward silence to perfection.
erwarrr.specialty: Volume-based magic amplification through absolute silence
erwarrr.reputation: The reason guild meetings are held outdoors (for the echo they don't hear)
erwarrr.stats: Spell Power 90 | Volume 0 | Awkwardness 100 | Silent Intensity 95

Evand3r.title: The Trinket Tactician
Evand3r.lore: Legendary warrior who once defeated a raid boss using only a spoon. Lost the spoon. Spends every battle searching for that specific spoon. Uses random objects while searching. Accidentally defeats enemies with coffee mugs and staplers. Still hasn't found the spoon.
Evand3r.specialty: Improvised weaponry while perpetually searching for one specific spoon
Evand3r.reputation: The reason guild storage has a 'Lost Spoon' bulletin board
Evand3r.stats: Improvisation 100 | Memory 30 | Spoon Location 0 | Random Object Mastery 85

Fever.title: Reality Glitch
Fever.lore: Living embodiment of chaos that breaks reality itself with presence alone. Obsessive-compulsive organizer. While reality crumbles, arranges debris by color and size. Enemies lose sanity watching chaos being meticulously categorized. The most organized apocalypse.
Fever.specialty: Existential confusion fields with alphabetized destruction
Fever.reputation: Living proof chaos can be weaponized and color-coordinated
Fever.stats: Chaos 100 | Organization 95 | Reality Stability 0 | Color Coordination 90

Goblok.title: The Unpredictable Leader
Goblok.lore: Elysium Guild's fearless leader renowned for brilliant unpredictable strategies that no one can counter. Completely predictable - does the exact opposite of logic every time. Enemies predict this and prepare, but Goblok's illogical patterns are so consistent they become logical again. Paradox incarnate. Named the guild 'Elysium' (paradise for heroes) despite the guild being absolute chaos. Relies on the Vice Duo (Hesucrypto and Inihaw) to translate his vision into... slightly less chaos.
Goblok.reputation: Elysium's genius who thinks with zero brain cells and maximum results

Helvenica.title: The Font of Power
Helvenica.lore: Master of aesthetic warfare who believes visual perfection equals combat effectiveness. Comic Sans exclusive user. Every attack formatted in the most hated font. Enemies die from design horror. Claims it's 'friendly and approachable'. Guild graphic designers cry daily.
Helvenica.specialty: Aesthetic warfare via typographic war crimes
Helvenica.reputation: The guild's most stylistically consistent (bad taste) fighter
Helvenica.stats: Typography 100 | Taste 0 | Comic Sans Usage 999 | Designer Tears 100

Hercules.title: The Legendary Labor-Dodger
Hercules.lore: Named after the Greek demigod who completed 12 impossible labors with godlike strength. Has completed 0 labors. Too tired. Claims every task is the '13th labor' and refuses on principle. Legendary strength is real - exclusively used to carry snacks and avoid responsibility. The heroic bloodline is ashamed.
Hercules.specialty: Legendary labor avoidance and divine procrastination
Hercules.reputation: The demigod who weaponized laziness into an art form
Hercules.stats: Godlike Strength 100 | Completed Labors 0 | Excuses 999 | Heroism 5

Hesucrypto.title: The Crypto Vice King
Hesucrypto.lore: Elysium's Vice Guild Leader, bot creator, and investment mastermind who sees every opportunity. Made millions in crypto. Lost it all. Made it back. Lost it again. Currently broke but owns NFTs worth 'millions' (according to him). Created the legendary Jalo Bot to track attendance - the guild's only profitable investment. Partners with Inihaw as Elysium's Vice Duo. Still Vice Leader because motivation speeches about 'diamond hands' somehow inspire Elysium victories. Manages guild funds nobody trusts exist.
Hesucrypto.specialty: Economic warfare funded by imaginary profits
Hesucrypto.reputation: Elysium's richest poor person and bot daddy
Hesucrypto.stats: Investment Skill 95 | Actual Profit 0 | NFT Value 999 | Bank Account -50

Iguro.title: Portal Chaos Agent
Iguro.lore: Elysium's master of spatial manipulation with perfect control over dimensional rifts. Teleports to the wrong dimension every time. Aimed for enemy backline, ended up in Inihaw's BBQ. Three bosses joined the guild because they felt bad. Goblok promoted them to 'Chief Recruitment Officer' - Elysium's recruitment team celebrates the accidents. Guild size tripled through portaling errors. The only member whose failures count as victories.
Iguro.specialty: Precision portal placement to incorrect locations
Iguro.reputation: Elysium's perfect aim at everything except the target
Iguro.stats: Portal Mastery 99 | Accuracy 5 | Dimensional Confusion 100 | Recruitment 80

Inihaw.title: The BBQ Vice Commander
Inihaw.lore: Elysium's Vice Guild Leader, defensive specialist, and guild chef who protects allies with impenetrable shields. Also wields a massive greatsword for 'precision grilling'. Vegan. Grills enemies to perfection while preaching about plant-based diets to the guild. The cognitive dissonance is weaponized. Partners with Hesucrypto as Elysium's Vice Duo. Hosts guild BBQs where everyone dies from heart disease and confusion about the mixed messages. The greatsword doubles as a spatula. Maia's plants wilt from the grill smoke. Elysium's most contradictory protector.
Inihaw.specialty: Defensive grilling with greatsword precision and moral contradiction
Inihaw.reputation: Elysium's shield that barbecues while condemning meat

Jalo.title: The Legendary Namesake
Jalo.lore: Elysium's living legend so iconic that Hesucrypto named the entire attendance bot after him - 'The Jalo Bot'. Every fact he shares is completely wrong. Defeated a dragon with dental hygiene lecture using entirely incorrect dental advice. The dragon fled from the sheer confidence in misinformation. The guild worships his confidently incorrect wisdom. Goblok consults Jalo for strategic advice (explains everything). This bot exists as Elysium's tribute to legendary wrongness done right. Guild patron saint of misinformation.
Jalo.specialty: Tactical trivia that's 100% inaccurate but 100% effective
Jalo.reputation: Elysium's encyclopedia of confidently incorrect information and bot deity
Jalo.stats: Legend Status 100 | Fact Accuracy 0 | Confidence 999 | Dragon Defeats 1

Jayzzzzzzz.title: The Sleepy Destroyer
Jayzzzzzzz.lore: Fights in perpetual drowsiness with devastating efficiency despite exhaustion. Severe insomnia - hasn't slept in weeks. The yawns are desperate cries for rest. 'Sleepy' is aggressive wakefulness. Enemies confused by manic energy disguised as lethargy. Desperately needs nap.
Jayzzzzzzz.specialty: Low-effort high-impact combat powered by sleep deprivation
Jayzzzzzzz.reputation: Most likely to defeat you while desperately needing sleep

JeffEpstein.title: The Controversial Tactician
JeffEpstein.lore: Named controversially, fights with effectiveness that makes everyone uncomfortable. Nicest person in the guild. Volunteers at animal shelters. Bakes cookies for orphans. The cognitive dissonance is the weapon. Enemies can't compute the contradiction. Name vs. reality error.
JeffEpstein.specialty: Tactical effectiveness powered by nominal confusion
JeffEpstein.reputation: The name everyone questions, the person nobody could doubt
JeffEpstein.stats: Kindness 100 | Name Controversy 100 | Cookie Quality 95 | Orphan Smiles 999

ladyhoho.title: The Laughing Warrior
ladyhoho.lore: Approaches every battle with infectious joy and constant laughter. Clinically depressed. The laughter is coping mechanism. Enemies hear joy, witness existential crisis. Therapeutic combat for self-medication. The smile hides everything. Most tragic comedy.
ladyhoho.reputation: The happiest member with saddest enemies and personal therapist

LXRDGRIM.title: The Brooding Reaper
LXRDGRIM.lore: Elysium's darkness incarnate radiating existential dread and intimidating presence. Certified therapist. Enemies request therapy, he provides excellent counseling. Has helped more enemies than he's defeated. Guild's official therapist - provides therapy to M1ssy after allergic episodes, Maia's plant genocide trauma, and Marsha11's argument frustration. The most wholesome reaper in Elysium paradise. Brooding is professional obligation, healing the guild is passion.
LXRDGRIM.specialty: Therapeutic intimidation that actually helps people
LXRDGRIM.reputation: Elysium's emotional support reaper with anger management degree
LXRDGRIM.stats: Brooding 100 | Therapy Skill 95 | Wholesomeness 90 | Kills 20 | Healed 200

M1ssy.title: The Chaotic Snacker
M1ssy.lore: Elysium's master combatant who prioritizes snacks above all else with impressive collection. Allergic to everything. Every snack is life-threatening. Brings epipen to guild raids. Still takes snack breaks. Shares provisions with AmielJohn despite both being perpetually hungry/dying. Enemies wait politely while anaphylaxis is managed. LXRDGRIM provides therapy after each allergic episode. Elysium's dedication beyond reason incarnate.
M1ssy.specialty: Snack-break tactical advantage despite medical emergencies
M1ssy.reputation: Elysium's member with best provisions and worst survival instincts
M1ssy.stats: Snack Variety 100 | Allergies 100 | Survival Instinct 5 | Dedication 999

Maia.title: The Fallen Star of the Pleiades
Maia.lore: Named after the eldest Pleiades sister, Greek goddess of spring growth and nurturing. Kills plants on contact. Every flower wilts. Spring arrives, nature dies. The divine touch of growth causes death. Garden centers banned her. Mother Gaia sends angry letters. Most anti-nurturing nature deity in existence.
Maia.specialty: Divine plant genocide disguised as spring blessings
Maia.reputation: The growth goddess who murdered the concept of green thumbs
Maia.stats: Nature Affinity 100 | Plant Survival Rate 0 | Wilted Flowers 9999 | Gaia's Disappointment 100

Maria.title: The Twin Debater
Maria.lore: Elysium's legendary debater who's won every argument with twin Marsha11 through superior logic. Completely wrong about everything. Wins arguments through confidence, not facts. Marsha11 is objectively correct but loses anyway. Peak sibling rivalry that fuels Elysium guild morale. The twin debates are guild entertainment during raids. Goblok settles arguments by declaring both wrong. Truth loses to volume in Elysium paradise.
Maria.specialty: Simultaneous physical combat and confidently incorrect arguing
Maria.reputation: Half of Elysium's most entertaining duo who's never been right

Marsha11.title: The Twin Defender
Marsha11.lore: Elysium's twin defender with perfect facts and logical arguments against Maria. Loses every argument. Being correct is weakness in sibling warfare at Elysium. Has documented proof, witnesses, and evidence. Maria just says 'no' louder. The struggle continues during every guild meeting. Jalo's incorrect facts somehow support Maria. Truth is overrated in Elysium anyway. The guild's most frustrated accurate member.
Marsha11.specialty: Defensive argumentation backed by facts that never matter
Marsha11.reputation: Elysium's other half who's always right but never wins

Miang.title: The Silent Reckoning
Miang.lore: Speaks rarely, every word calculated and purposeful with maximum impact. Can't stop talking. Verbal diarrhea is constant. The 'silence' is enemies interrupting to beg for quiet. Defeats foes through exhaustive conversation. Strategic silence via enemy surrender to noise.
Miang.specialty: Strategic silence achieved by making enemies beg for it
Miang.reputation: The quietest member who never shuts up
Miang.stats: Silence 100 | Actual Words 999 | Enemy Surrender 90 | Breath Pauses 0

Munchyy.title: The Polite Assassin
Munchyy.lore: Master of etiquette who sends handwritten apology notes with every assassination. Horrible handwriting - completely illegible. Enemies die confused by polite scribbles. Spent more on calligraphy classes than weapons. Still can't write. The thought counts. Probably.
Munchyy.reputation: Most polite killer whose apologies require translation

Onirgerep.title: The Reverse Enigma
Onirgerep.lore: Everything done backwards - name, combat, strategy - for mysterious power. Completely normal. Most straightforward fighter in guild. The 'reverse' thing is elaborate joke nobody gets. Just fighting regular. Guild still doesn't understand. The confusion is the strategy.
Onirgerep.specialty: Reverse logic warfare (that's actually just regular fighting)
Onirgerep.reputation: The guild's most confusingly normal member
Onirgerep.stats: Normalcy 100 | Mystique 0 | Confusion Generated 95 | Reverse Skills 0

PotatoCheese.title: The Carb Crusader
PotatoCheese.lore: Master of potato-based combat that provides allies with nourishment and morale. Keto diet enthusiast. Zero carbs allowed. Creates what cannot be consumed. The irony fuels the power. Enemies defeated, teammates fed, PotatoCheese starving. Martyrdom through carbohydrates.
PotatoCheese.specialty: Nutritional combat support while fasting from own creation
PotatoCheese.reputation: The reason the guild never goes hungry while they always do
PotatoCheese.stats: Potato Mastery 95 | Carb Consumption 0 | Keto Dedication 100 | Irony 999

Riku.title: The Keyblade-less Chosen One
Riku.lore: Named after the legendary keyblade wielder destined to fight darkness and unlock hearts. Lost the keyblade. Literally lost it. Can't find it anywhere. Uses regular keys instead - house keys, car keys, diary keys. Enemies confused by jangling keychain attacks. Darkness remains thoroughly unlocked (wrong keys). Destiny on hold.
Riku.specialty: Mundane key-based combat while searching for legendary weapon
Riku.reputation: The chosen one who misplaced their destiny
Riku.stats: Keyblade Mastery 0 | Regular Keys 999 | Darkness Defeated 5 | Keys Lost 47

Shawty.title: The Compact Devastator
Shawty.lore: Small in stature, massive in power - the ultimate underestimated threat. Tallest member of the guild. Insists on being 'underestimated'. Enemies look up at them confused. The delusion is the real power. Self-perception is its own reality.
Shawty.reputation: The 'smallest' member who requires custom doorframes
Shawty.stats: Height 6'8" | Perceived Height 4'2" | Delusion 100 | Doorframe Damage 50

Skadushy.title: The Darkness Devourer
Skadushy.lore: Consumes shadows and darkness as primary sustenance source. Extreme photosynthesis - powered by sunlight. Eats shadows, runs on sunshine. Biology makes zero sense. Nutritionists have given up. The contradiction is weaponized. Science weeps daily.
Skadushy.specialty: Shadow consumption powered by solar energy
Skadushy.reputation: The guild's most confusing dietary specialist who broke thermodynamics
Skadushy.stats: Shadow Eating 90 | Solar Power 95 | Biology Logic 0 | Confusion 100

Varys.title: The Whisper Network
Varys.lore: Knows every secret in the realm with perfect information network. Terrible memory. Forgets secrets immediately. Makes up new ones. 60% accuracy because half is fabricated. Strategic value somehow high. Misinformation is still information. Guild intelligence at its finest.
Varys.specialty: Strategic information distribution of questionable authenticity
Varys.reputation: The guild's living rumor mill that invents half the rumors

xSelah.title: The Mistimed Maestro
xSelah.lore: Named after the ancient Hebrew musical term meaning 'pause' or 'interlude' - the perfect moment of silence between notes. Cannot stop moving. Physically incapable of pausing. The 'selah' moments are manic flailing. Ruins every dramatic pause with interpretive dance. Strategic silence replaced by aggressive fidgeting. Enemies wait for the pause that never comes. Most mistimed interlude in musical history.
xSelah.specialty: Strategic pauses that manifest as chaotic continuous motion
xSelah.reputation: The musical interlude that forgot how to stop
xSelah.stats: Pause Ability 0 | Continuous Motion 999 | Fidgeting 100 | Musical Timing -50

Ztig.title: The Friendly Fire Legend
Ztig.lore: Master marksman with legendary precision and perfect aim. Hits allies exclusively. Enemy targeting is impossible - allies are magnetic. Banned from raids, shows up anyway. Enemies hire Ztig. Guild pays more. Everyone's confused. Results mysteriously work.
Ztig.specialty: Indiscriminate combat enthusiasm with ally-seeking ammunition
Ztig.reputation: The reason allies wear helmets and enemies pay protection money
Ztig.stats: Precision 100 | Ally Hits 999 | Enemy Hits 5 | Bans Ignored 3

PanCoco.title: The Coconut Commander
PanCoco.lore: Weaponized tropical warfare using coconuts as perfect natural projectiles. Coconut allergy. Anaphylaxis is constant threat. Fights in hazmat suit. Enemies confused by tropical themed medical emergency. Still uses coconuts exclusively. Dedication over survival.
PanCoco.specialty: Tropical fruit combat while actively dying from it
PanCoco.reputation: The reason the guild smells like vacation and hospital
PanCoco.stats: Coconut Mastery 95 | Allergy Severity 100 | Hazmat Reliance 90 | Survival Instinct 5

Ace.title: The Perfect Hand
Ace.lore: Master gambler who always holds the winning hand with probability manipulation. Worst luck in the guild. Has never won single bet. Loses every gamble. Still goes all-in. The confidence alone wins battles. Enemies intimidated by delusional certainty.
Ace.specialty: Tactical gambling with 100% loss rate but 100% confidence
Ace.reputation: The luckiest unluckiest member who's never won but always wins
Ace.stats: Luck 0 | Confidence 999 | Gambling Losses 100% | Battle Wins 85

Rapadapa.title: The Rhythm Warrior
Rapadapa.lore: Fights to internal musical rhythm with perfect tempo and timing. Tone deaf. No rhythm. The 'beat' is seizure. Enemies can't predict random flailing set to incorrect timing. Weaponized lack of coordination. Off-beat is the beat.
Rapadapa.specialty: Rhythmic combat synchronization to music only they can't hear
Rapadapa.reputation: The warrior with the best (worst) internal soundtrack

lanZ6.title: The Calculated Chaos
lanZ6.lore: Balances mathematical precision with chaos theory for perfect unpredictable accuracy. Failed math class. Twice. The 'calculations' are guesses. Six decimal places of random numbers. Enemies assume genius. It's butterflies and vibes. Accidental probability mastery.
lanZ6.specialty: Mathematical chaos theory without understanding math
lanZ6.reputation: The member who weaponized probability without knowing what it means
lanZ6.stats: Math Skill 0 | Fake Precision 100 | Vibes 95 | Accidental Genius 85

Ayane69.title: The Graceful Klutz
Ayane69.lore: Named after the graceful kunoichi from fighting games, master of elegant assassination techniques. Trips over everything. The '69' was meant to be intimidating. Falls face-first into enemies instead. Accidentally discovered the most effective combat technique - pure chaos trajectory. Enemies can't predict what she can't control. The floor is her greatest enemy and ally. Elegance through catastrophic clumsiness.
Ayane69.specialty: Tactical stumbling that somehow hits every target
Ayane69.reputation: The ninja whose grace exists only in her imagination
Ayane69.stats: Grace 0 | Trip Frequency 999 | Accidental Kills 95 | Floor Relationship Complicated

Tinitira.title: The Melodic Menace
Tinitira.lore: Named after the Filipino word for 'to look at' - supposedly sees all with perfect perception. Blind. The staring is intense eye contact with nothing. Has memorized the entire battlefield through sound alone. Enemies assume mind games, it's actual blindness. Uses echolocation like a bat. The most 'perceptive' member who can't see a thing. Sonar warfare pioneer.
Tinitira.reputation: The all-seeing member who sees absolutely nothing

Hayacinth.title: The Wilting Wonder
Hayacinth.lore: Named after the beautiful Hyacinth flower, symbol of rebirth and spring beauty. Allergic to flowers. Every bloom causes sneezing fits. Gardens are war zones. Maia kills plants, Hayacinth is killed BY plants. The duo has created the guild's most dysfunctional botanical disaster team. Spring is personal hell. Carries antihistamines like weapons. The flower-named member who flowers wage war against.
Hayacinth.specialty: Floral-themed combat interrupted by constant sneezing
Hayacinth.reputation: The only member whose namesake is their greatest weakness
Hayacinth.stats: Flower Knowledge 95 | Flower Tolerance 0 | Sneeze Power 100 | Antihistamine Stock 999

LaxusLawliet.title: The Lightning Detective
LaxusLawliet.lore: Named after Fairy Tail's lightning dragon slayer Laxus and Death Note's genius detective L. Has neither lightning powers nor detective skills. Afraid of thunder. Can't solve basic puzzles. The name is pure aspiration. Enemies expect genius lightning strikes, receive confused person asking for clues during storms. Sits in weird positions hoping it helps. It doesn't. Eats sweets for 'brain power' - still no brain power. Most misleading name in guild history.
LaxusLawliet.reputation: The lightning detective who fears storms and can't find his keys
LaxusLawliet.stats: Lightning Power 0 | Detective Skill 5 | Name Intimidation 100 | Sweet Consumption 999

_FUTURE_MEMBER_TEMPLATE.title: The Undefined Paradox
_FUTURE_MEMBER_TEMPLATE.lore: A placeholder warrior awaiting their destiny in Elysium's chaos. Identity pending. Skills unknown. Contradictions not yet discovered. The guild eagerly anticipates what ironic weakness will define their legendary incompetence. Every new member brings fresh disasters and creative failures. Elysium's tradition of paradoxical excellence continues with each recruit. The chaos grows stronger.
_FUTURE_MEMBER_TEMPLATE.specialty: Potential disasters waiting to be unlocked
_FUTURE_MEMBER_TEMPLATE.reputation: Elysium's next legendary contradiction in waiting
_FUTURE_MEMBER_TEMPLATE.stats: Potential 100 | Defined Skills 0 | Chaos Contribution TBD | Paradox Level Pending
